prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: seamless horizontal kinesiology-tape material strip for a long production CSS band
Primary request: Recreate only the vivid electric cobalt kinesiology-tape material visible in the approved Kinetic Tape Atlas mock as a clean reusable horizontal production texture. The whole frame is the blue tape material, designed to repeat seamlessly from left to right across a long CSS band.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved visual reference for the exact saturated cobalt role, athletic physicality, woven surface, and restrained lighting only; do not reproduce any interface, anatomy, or geometry from the mock.
Scene/backdrop: flat front-facing material plate filling the entire frame edge to edge
Style/medium: high-resolution photoreal material scan of premium kinesiology tape
Composition/framing: extremely wide horizontal crop; uniform material scale across the width; perfectly matching left and right edges for horizontal tiling; top and bottom show subtle softly rolled physical tape edges within the material crop, without exposing a surrounding scene; no perspective, no focal object
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse even studio illumination, energetic but controlled, no cast shadow and no shadowed scene
Color palette: vivid electric cobalt blue close to #1261e8, with restrained darker and lighter blue fiber variation only
Materials/textures: visible fine woven cotton fibers, soft adhesive athletic tape surface, slight tensile wrinkles traveling mostly along the length, gently softened physical edge character, tactile but not rough
Constraints: no text, no typography, no logos, no symbols, no interface, no human, no body, no anatomy, no hands, no roll, no dispenser, no objects, no background scene, no gradients, no border, no rounded rectangle, no watermark; edge-to-edge opaque blue material is required; designed as a seamless horizontal tile at 1536 x 384 or larger
Avoid: bandage roll product shot, floating strip, white background, dark shadow, dramatic folds, torn or frayed ends, diagonal composition, glossy plastic, neoprene, denim, carbon fiber, moire, grunge, dirt, scratches, light hotspot, vignette, color drift toward cyan or purple
